title: Seeing Wes at the Jazz Workshop
summary: After a Tjader concert Monk squeezed into the Workshop and saw Wes was clearly on his way.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: When Wes came out and made a...and I could really see the impact of what was happening. And it was so strong, it was so definite. There was no question about it, he was on his way. They worked at Jazz Workshop. The night he worked at Jazz Workshop, I was playing a concert with Cal over at -- what's the name of that place, the Music Hall or something like that. We played a concert and we got out and rushed over to the Workshop, and couldn't get near it. Couldn't get near.

And I wiggled my way trying to get...finally got up to the door and I knew the guy working the door, and they made room for me. Just an exception because...Wes was there and everything. And I came in and saw him, and I was watching him perform on the stage, and you knew he was on his way, that people was looking for that sound.
